items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: if like when Isaiah joined the band I was like, “Okay, you learned the Nat Cole stuff, great, that’s something.”

ctx.x: Are your charts chord charts with cues for riffs and breaks and that kind of thing?

No they’re just chord charts and then I’ll send them the record so I said you know, “You’ll see where the shout chorus is.” And to me that’s the funny part is like I like the guy to learn the tunes and if like when Isaiah joined the band I was like, “Okay, you learned the Nat Cole stuff, great, that’s something.” But when we do, I’m not a stickler for like, “Hey we’re going to all do this.” I like it to sort of organically happen, to say like, you know, “Be on the lookout, I may play a figure we could all play it…
